notes: v2 taxonomy for OpenSwitchboard. goods.*, services.* and social.* are open; work.* and property.* are reserved. A node may also carry "status": "reserved" with a "reserved_reason" - licensed-trade for work that needs a licence, regulated-vertical for a family held back deliberately at launch. A category may be posted only when its top level is open and no node on its path (itself included) is reserved. Every leaf that may be posted also carries a "phrase": the node as a person says it inside a sentence, where the label is the heading a catalogue would print. "Mountain bikes" is the label, "mountain bike" is the phrase, and the phrase is what goes after "your" and after "the ... you are after". A phrase is countable unless the node says "countable": false, which is how mass nouns ("climbing gear") and the phrases people keep plural ("guitar lessons") say they take no article. "article" is spelled out only where the phrase does not predict it, as in "an Xbox". The taxonomy is maintained by the operator in public (benevolent-dictator for now; a governance group is planned once third-party verticals exist). See CONTRIBUTING.md for the taxonomy-change process.
